cardMap.places.outside: places "{path}": it is not inside {goal} (only cards inside a goal can be placed on the contents map)
cardMap.places.shape: places is a {top_left} for each path of a card inside the goal (example: {"Goals:Design": {"topLeft": {"x": 0, "y": 0}}})
cardMap.places.sizeNotHere: places "{path}": write only topLeft in places of the contents map (change the size of {kind} with size in the value of card_update on that card)
cardMap.places.stray: places "{path}" has keys that cannot be used: {keys}. Only topLeft can be used
